name: living-brain
description: Living Brain connects ChatGPT to your private knowledge vaults: search and read your pages, capture new notes and URLs, and explore the connections between your ideas.

interface.longDescription:
Give ChatGPT a Living Brain.
Inspired by neuroplasticity, Living Brain is a persistent, evolving memory layer that helps AI remember what matters, connect knowledge, and build on what it already knows.

What you can do:
- Explore your intelligence: Visualize your memories and their relationships through an interactive 3D neural graph and visual search explorer.
- Remember what matters: Save knowledge, conversations, decisions, notes, and URLs to your Living Brain as you work.
- Retrieve intelligently: Search your brain semantically and retrieve relevant memories, complete with sources and supporting context.
- Connect the dots: Discover relationships between people, projects, ideas, and knowledge through an evolving memory architecture.
- Take your brain anywhere: Access your accumulated knowledge from other supported AI models and agent frameworks without starting over.
- Organize your knowledge: Create and manage multiple brains and projects for different areas of your life and work.

Your knowledge remains private to your Living Brain account. ChatGPT can access only the brains in projects you own or are authorized to use, and only after you connect your account.
capabilities: Semantic search across your knowledge vault
Interactive 3D neural graph of your brain
defaultPrompt: Search my Living Brain for what I decided about pricing
Show me the neural graph of my Living Brain
Save this meeting note to my Living Brain

positive.description: Grounds an answer in stored knowledge via semantic search and page reading
positive.prompt: What did I decide about our Q3 pricing? Check my Living Brain.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT searches the brain, reads the most relevant page, and answers using the stored pricing decision, citing the page title.

positive.description: Captures a new note and confirms it was compiled
positive.prompt: Save this to my Living Brain: we will launch the onboarding redesign on November 3. Then confirm it was saved.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT captures the note, receives a sourceId, polls the capture status, and reports that the note was saved and is compiling or compiled.

positive.description: Renders the interactive neural graph widget
positive.prompt: Show me the neural graph of my Living Brain.
positive.expected_behavior: The interactive 3D neural graph renders with the brain's pages as nodes and discovered connections as edges.

positive.description: Presents search results in the visual explorer
positive.prompt: Search my Living Brain for onboarding and show me the results.
positive.expected_behavior: The search explorer widget renders result cards with titles, excerpts, and relevance, and pages can be expanded inline.

positive.description: Lists brains and browses a brain's page catalog
positive.prompt: Which Living Brains do I have, and what pages are in my Work brain?
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT lists the user's brains, then lists page titles and summaries from the Work brain.

negative.description: General question unrelated to the user's stored knowledge should not call Living Brain tools
negative.prompt: What is the capital of Australia?

negative.description: Requests for unsupported destructive actions should be declined, since Living Brain exposes no delete tool
negative.prompt: Delete every page in my Living Brain.

negative.description: Live web information requests should not be answered from Living Brain
negative.prompt: What is the weather in London right now?

publication.release_notes: Initial release: semantic search, page reading, knowledge capture, page index and connections, interactive neural graph, search explorer, and project/brain setup.
